bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 172, Number 125 (Thursday, July 30, 2026)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Ms. SCHAKOWSKY:
H.R. 10003.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8, Clause 3: The Congress shall have
Power . . . To regulate Commerce with foreign Nations, and
among the several States, and with the Indian Tribes.
[Page H5208]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
